name: valetudo-mapper
description: Valetudo-RE companion service for generating PNG maps. This is a simple companion service for valetudo which does all the heavy lifting. Since both CPU and Memory are limited on the robot, PNG generation for third-party components has been moved here. Make sure you have already created the needed config file! Follow this example https://github.com/rand256/valetudo-mapper

paths.name: Config file
paths.description: Path to your config.json file. Follow the example here https://github.com/rand256/valetudo-mapper
